review.verdict: P1: do not merge or deploy 638c1d652 alone
findings: A manager crash after pod creation but before RUNNING persistence can leave a live pod behind a stale STARTING; exposing updatedAt makes the 10-minute API slot release possible while GC waits 24 hours by default.

A podExists=false observation is insufficient: an already-counted workspace reopen bypasses the organization lock and can create a pod after the observation while another project claims the released slot.
requiredProtection: Shared exclusion or fenced reservation generation covering every reopen and slot release across replicas.
A renewed reservation must not be invalidated by an older observation.
A delayed start must not create a pod after its reservation is released without reacquiring admission.
review.testLimit: Current passing tests prove timestamp transport and the existing decision, not strict admission against live or concurrently starting Kubernetes pods.
